- `ClassCastException` if the class of the specified element prevents it from being added to the set. This is not checked in the given code, so it is not avoided.
- `NullPointerException` if the specified element is `null` and this set does not permit `null` elements. This is avoided by the `checkNotNull` method.
- `IllegalArgumentException` if some property of the specified element prevents it from being added to the set. This is not checked in the given code, so it is not avoided.
